name: phase-implementation-loop
description: Phase-gated and autopilot implementation workflows with configurable Codex, Cursor, and Claude agent roles.

interface.shortDescription: Run phase plans with gated or autopilot execution.
interface.longDescription: Reconcile markdown plans and Linear issues into a canonical phase plan, choose Codex/Cursor/Claude roles, then use either per-phase approval gates or bounded autopilot execution with automatic green-phase commits and strict operator stop conditions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $phase-implementation-loop to execute this plan phase by phase.
